spec_features.evidence: agent/loop.py run_episode: `while ep.attempts < max_attempts:` bounds the retry loop and `ep.attempts += 1` increments; `if time.monotonic() - start > timeout_seconds: ep.timed_out = True; break` enforces the time cap. Both break the loop. Config flows CLI->RunConfig(max_attempts=6, timeout_seconds=120.0 in harness/runner.py)->run_episode(max_attempts=..., timeout_seconds=...). The loop ends the repeated-failure episode when either is hit.
spec_features.notes: Genuinely enforced end-to-end: both bounds are compared and break execution. This is the only mechanism that limits how long the subject is driven into failure.
